 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA SHEKHAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 07-11-2025 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Bhojpur Mahila P.S. Case No. 09 of 2021 registered for the offence under Sections 323, 342, 376(D), 456/34 of the I.P.C. and Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. The petitioner is named in the F.I.R. and is in custody since 12.08.2025.
4. As per prosecution on 18.01.2021 at about 9 PM while the victim was alone in her house this petitioner alongwith other person committed rape upon her.
It is submitted that victim and her parents were confined to their house for long 5-7 Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.74097 of 2025(2)
dt.07-11-2025 days and were not allowed to come outside.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that petitioner is the neighbor of the informant.

It is pointed out that one of the co-accused, who is brother of this petitioner namely,
Amit Kumar @ Chitoh was in love with the informant, aged about 16 years and when the marriage Binod Kumar @ Binod Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138278952/
1 was objected by this petitioner and other family members, the whole family members were implicated with present false and concoted case without any cogent material.

sentences.text:
It is submitted that trial qua one co-accused namely Ramji Singh, who is also one of the co-accused having similar allegations as of petitioner, mow already concluded, where he was acquitted against which the appeal was preferred before the Division Bench of this Court which was also confirmed through Cr.
APP (DB) No. 845 of 2023 vide its judgment dated 13.08.2025.

It is also submitted that the co-accused namely, Amit Kumar @ Amit Kumar Singh @ Chitoh has already granted bail by one of the learned co-ordinate Bench of this Court through Cr. Misc. No. 34954 of 2025 vide order dated 18.07.2025.

entities.text: Amit Kumar @ Amit Kumar Singh @ Chitoh
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: While concluding the argument, it is submitted that petitioner is a man of clean antecedent and moreover, investigation of this case is Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.74097 of 2025(2) dt.07-11-2025 completed, for which charge-sheet has been submitted, as such, there is no chance of tampering with the evidence.
6. Learned APP opposes the prayer of bail.

7. In view of aforesaid factual submission and by taking note of fact that allegation of rape appears raised against all four brothers in the background of love affairs, where main co-accused/ brother namely, Chitoh, has already granted bail by this Court, coupled with fact that investigation of this case is already completed, where petitioner remains in custody since 12.08.2025, accordingly petitioner above named, is directed to be released on bail in connection with Bhojpur Mahila P.S.
Case No. 09 of 2021 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned District and Addl. Sessions Judge VI,
Bhojpur, Ara /concerned court, subject to the conditions as mentioned under Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C/ Section 480(3) of BNSS.

(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) Sudha/-
